summary: Iran reports an "enemy" strike on its IRGC naval base at Sirik near the Strait of Hormuz and claims retaliation against a U.S. radar in Bahrain. Israel struck Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander at Nasser Hospital in Gaza and a vehicle near Shifa Hospital, while West Bank operations netted over 55 suspects. Lebanon recorded 111 alerts, 38 drone sightings, seven airstrikes, and 30 artillery barrages on November 12.
key_points: Iran's IRNA says Sirik, home to the IRGC Shahid Rahbari naval base, was hit by a military strike of unknown origin. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9922)
Iran's Revolutionary Guards claim they attacked a U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to the Sirik strike. (Source: @yediotnews25/137782)
IDF confirms strike on Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail at Nasser Hospital; he was responsible for holding hostages. (Source: @manniefabian/59513)
Israeli strike near Shifa Hospital in Gaza City killed one and injured several, per Palestinian media. (Source: @manniefabian/59509)
West Bank raids over the past week arrested more than 55 wanted Palestinians, seized weapons, and destroyed incitement monuments in Etzion Brigade. (Source: @yediotnews25/137787)
Lebanon daily report for Nov 12 shows 111 alerts, 38 drone detections, seven airstrikes, and 30 artillery shelling incidents across multiple villages. (Source: @redlinkleb/52939)
Unconfirmed reports indicate an air defense site in Bandar Lengeh, Hormozgan Province, was targeted. (Source: @shin_persian/12309)
Russia and Iran say they are coordinating against CENTCOM's new Task Force Iron Gate aimed at disrupting land-based weapons shipments. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9920)

sections.executive_summary: Iran reports an "enemy" strike on its IRGC naval base at Sirik near the Strait of Hormuz and claims retaliation against a U.S. radar in Bahrain. Israel struck Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander at Nasser Hospital in Gaza and a vehicle near Shifa Hospital, while West Bank operations netted over 55 suspects. Lebanon recorded 111 alerts, 38 drone sightings, seven airstrikes, and 30 artillery barrages on November 12.

points: Iran's state news agency IRNA reported that Sirik in Hormozgan province on the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an "enemy" strike described as "military in nature"; Sirik hosts the IRGC's Shahid Rahbari naval base and no actor has claimed responsibility. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9922)

The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced it attacked a U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain early morning in retaliation for the strike on the Sirik communications tower. (Source: @yediotnews25/137782)

Iranian state media released footage showing an Iranian ballistic missile launcher destroyed in an airstrike during the war while a second launcher nearby successfully fired a missile. (Source: @shin_persian/12301)
Initial unconfirmed reports and a photograph suggest an air defense site in Bandar Lengeh, Hormozgan Province, was targeted. (Source: @shin_persian/12309)
Iran attacked maritime navigation systems on Oman's Didamar Island in the Strait of Hormuz, according to a truncated report. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9913)

Tehran and Moscow say they are coordinating against CENTCOM's new Task Force Iron Gate, which aims to disrupt weapons shipments and sanctions violations over land routes. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9920)

The commander of the U.S. Fifth Fleet, Vice Admiral Kurt Renshaw, concluded a visit to Israel that included discussions with Israeli Navy Commander Maj. Gen. Eyal Harel on naval operations across active fronts and strengthening partnership for regional stability and maritime security. (Source: @N12chat/234868)

Northern District Police clarified that forces deployed in Rahat, including special units, snipers, and marksmen, are targeting armed shooters; in recent weeks they have seized numerous weapons, including stolen IDF ordnance. (Source: @N12chat/234860)

Prosecutors filed an indictment against a resident of Yafia for praising Yahya Sinwar and Ahmed Yassin and calling for jihad against Israel, including sharing a Hamas post on the anniversary of the October 2025 ceasefire violation that killed two Israeli officers. (Source: @yediotnews25/137779)

Yisrael Beiteinu leader Avigdor Lieberman announced he will formally assume the chairmanship of the Knesset Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee on Monday, stating the panel will oversee the defense establishment and prevent military moves for political purposes. (Source: @yediotnews25/137788)

IDF and Shin Bet struck Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail at Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza's Khan Younis; he assumed command after Muhammad al-Yazouri's killing in September and was responsible for holding hostages including Nimrod Cohen, Idan Alexander, Matan Zangauker, Avera Mengistu, and the bodies of Asaf Hamami, Oz Daniel, and Omer Neutra. (Source: @manniefabian/59513)

The strike also targeted Muawad Tawfiq Mahmoud Abu Zarifa, an engineering team commander in a Hamas combat and administrative support company, and Khaled Osama Abu Anza, head of communications in Hamas intelligence operations department. (Source: @manniefabian/59513)
Palestinian media reported one dead and several injured in an Israeli strike targeting a vehicle just outside Shifa Hospital in Gaza City. (Source: @manniefabian/59509)

Over the past week, IDF forces arrested more than 55 wanted Palestinians across Judea and Samaria, including Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives and suspects planning attacks, and confiscated numerous weapons; in the Etzion Brigade, monuments honoring terror founders and other militants were demolished. (Source: @yediotnews25/137787)

A Palestinian from the Jiftlik area in the Jordan Valley was arrested after arousing suspicion wearing military boots; a search of his home yielded an airsoft pistol, knives, military gear, and a classified military map of the Gaza envelope. (Source: @N12chat/234864)
A Red Alert incident at Nachal Oz Tzofar ended at 03:00 on 13/11/2026. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68585)
Palestinian outlets reported an explosive device detonated on the roof of the Hassan Allah family home in the Zeitoun neighborhood of southeastern Gaza City. (Source: @yediotnews25/137791)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's acknowledgment of a strike on its strategic naval base at Sirik and its claimed retaliation against a U.S. radar in Bahrain marks a direct escalation in Iranian–American confrontation in the Gulf. Simultaneous Israeli strikes on senior Hamas leadership in Khan Younis and near Shifa Hospital demonstrate continued pressure on Hamas's command structure and hostage-holding network. The high tempo of Lebanese front activity — 111 alerts and 30 artillery missions in a single day — indicates sustained cross-border fire. Coordination between Moscow and Tehran against CENTCOM's Task Force Iron Gate suggests a broader alignment to circumvent maritime interdiction efforts.
sections.regional_response: The U.S. Fifth Fleet commander's visit to Israel underscores deepening naval coordination amid Gulf tensions. Lebanese Army engineering units continue clearing war remnants, while Israeli police surge in the Negev targets illegal weapons flows including stolen IDF materiel. West Bank counterterrorism operations maintain pressure on Hamas and PIJ networks. Gulf states face heightened maritime risk from Iranian actions against navigation systems and alleged radar strikes.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian state media's release of footage showing a ballistic missile launcher destroyed alongside a successful launch serves both damage acknowledgment and resilience signaling. Unconfirmed reports of an air defense site strike in Bandar Lengeh, if verified, would indicate a wider targeting campaign against Iranian air defenses. The Jurf al-Sakhar pause in Iraq reflects ongoing intra-Shiite negotiations over security control. The classified Gaza envelope map found on a Jordan Valley suspect suggests intelligence-gathering efforts by Palestinian operatives inside Israel.
